instructions.title: How to compare prices
instructions.description: Compare the same kind of product to find the lowest price per unit.

step_1.title: Name each option
step_1.details: Add a name to tell products apart. This is optional.

step_2.title: Enter the total price and size
step_2.details: Use the price for the whole pack. Enter the size and unit of one item, then the number of items in the pack.

step_3.title: Add shipping if needed
step_3.details: Enter shipping for the whole pack, or leave it at 0.

step_4.title: Look for the lowest unit price
step_4.details: Compare the price per 100 g, per 100 ml, or per item. Shipping is included. The lowest unit price is highlighted.

step_5.title: Add another option
step_5.details: Choose “Add product” to compare more options.

step_6.title: Start a new comparison
step_6.details: Choose “Clear all” to remove your entries and start again.

instructions.note: Compare the same kind of product in one currency. Grams and kilograms convert automatically, as do ml and litres. Weight, volume, and item counts cannot be compared with each other.
